title: 316 King St N (Z-18-09)
body:
Application to amend zoning for 316 King St N
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
Milestone Developments Inc.is proposing to renovate the existing 10 storey building and add a 14 storey addition plus a 2 storey parking garage.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
rezoning the lands to residential mixed-use (RMU-81)
reducing building setbacks from the lot line as follows
in the front yard 5.0 m to 4.0 m (to facilitate additional road widening on King St. N.)
in the side yard 3.0 m to 1.0 m(south lot line –for parking structure)
in the rear yard 5.0 m to 1.4 m for exit stairs
in the rear yard 5.0 m to 2.0 m for parking access ramp
in the rear yard 5.0 m to 3.0 m for parking structure
reducing the landscape open requirement from 30% to 25%
reducing the parking from 111 spaces (0.9 per unit) to 93 spaces (0.756 per unit)
increasing the maximum horizontal tower dimension from 40 m to 46.15 m
reducing the tower separation requirements on the rear lot line from 11 m to 8 m and on the side lot line from 6 m to 4.8 m
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Tallest tower: 14 storeys depending on what is permitted
Number of units: 123
Unit sizes: mix of one, two and three bedroom units (193 bedrooms)
Housing types: apartments
Parking
Parking: 106Bicycle parking: 74
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
